testA_invalidProvider.description: Requesting an unsupported provider must throw, never return a usable success-reporting provider.

testB_sandboxLabeled.description: A deployment executed without real cloud credentials must be labeled executionMode=SANDBOX / isSandbox=true, and must never claim executionMode=REAL.

testC_malformedSpec.description: A malformed app spec (missing required fields) must fail safely, never fabricate success=true.

testD_credentialedRealFailure.description: A deployment with credentials present whose real API call fails must be reported as executionMode=REAL, success=false, status=FAILED — never SANDBOX, never a fabricated resource.

testE_credentialedRealSuccess.description: A deployment with credentials present whose real API call succeeds must be reported as executionMode=REAL, success=true, status=SUCCEEDED.
